citations.quote: Arista Networks is pivotal in AI infrastructure, supplying high-speed networking gear that connects GPUs for major cloud providers like Microsoft and Meta. ANET's earnings have surged since 2021, driving a 56.99% YTD total return and earning an A+ performance grade in the Gunderson Grading System. My valuation model estimates a five-year target price of $404.76, implying 96.77% upside from $205.70, though the current 60x earnings multiple is supported by only five years of rapid growth.

Arista Networks dominates the high-speed networking market for artificial intelligence data centers and cloud titans. International Business Machines has successfully pivoted toward high-margin hybrid cloud software and consulting services.
TEL, ANET, ROST, IT and PCAR stand out as cash-rich, high-ROE stocks screened for strong efficiency amid elevated market volatility.

Goldman Sachs sees hyperscalers accelerating toward a spending level that dwarfs anything the tech industry has attempted before, and the companies positioned to profit most may have nothing to do with the chips getting all the attention.
